articulation.label: hot
articulation.alt: hot: /h/ → /ɑ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: pot
articulation.alt: pot: /p/ → /ɑ/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: top
articulation.alt: top: /t/ → /ɑ/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: log
articulation.alt: log: /l/ → /ɑ/ → /ɡ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/ɡ/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; add voice.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
